content:
The City of Laredo is holding an Arbor Day tree-planting event on Saturday, November 7, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at Laredo International Airport, 5210 Bob Bullock Loop.

Attendees can take home a tree, with a limit of one tree per household while supplies last.

Source: City of Laredo, November 5, 2026.

title: Laredo Arbor Day tree-planting event set for Saturday at the airport
